about_the_game:
Moonless Night is a 2D retro-style psychological horror and survival game, where you’ll descend into the mind of Selene to uncover the sins that bind her. But she’s not alone—others wander this place, each carrying secrets waiting to be revealed.

“Light purifies sins, and flames consume sinners.”

Selene awakens in an unknown world with no memory of how she arrived. Her only clues are fragments of fading memories and cryptic pages that whisper of a past she cannot escape.

Features

  • Uncover Selene’s story – Guide her through a world where her only hope of freedom lies in confronting her past.

  • Explore a labyrinth of shadows – A place filled with hidden truths about Selene and others trapped within.

  • Run from the darkness, seek the light – Every choice draws you closer to salvation… or damnation.

  • Face your sins – The truth awaits those who dare.

  • Solve puzzles – Test your mind with challenging puzzles to unlock tools and paths to survive

  • Multiple endings – Your actions shape Selene’s fate, leading to six different conclusions.

A grim and silent world awaits. There are no weapons, only fear. Hide, escape, and discover. With high replayability, every playthrough brings new possibilities, new paths, and new endings.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may include content that is unsuitable for all age groups or inappropriate for viewing in professional settings, including frequent instances of violence, gore, and themes of suicide.
